description_ru: Автор объясняет, почему он предпочитает бумажные книги электронным, и признаёт плюсы экранов.
text:
Some people say that paper books are old-fashioned and that everybody will soon read on screens. I disagree, and I would like to explain why.

First of all, I remember what I read much better when I hold a real book. I can feel how far I have travelled through the story, and I often recall the exact place on the page where I read something important. On a phone, every page looks the same, so my memory gets confused.

Second, a screen is full of temptations. When I read an e-book, a message arrives, a notification shines, and suddenly I have spent twenty minutes on videos instead of the novel. A paper book has never interrupted me. It simply waits patiently until I come back.

Third, books are beautiful objects. A shelf of books makes a room feel warm and personal. If you visit someone's home, you can learn a lot about them just by looking at what they have read.

Of course, I understand the advantages of e-readers. They are light, they are cheap, and you can carry a thousand stories on a long journey. If I travelled every week, I would probably use one myself.

However, I believe the best reading happens slowly, quietly and without any buzzing devices. That is why I will always keep a few paper books beside my bed, even in the digital age.

Язык так же между зубами, но включите голос, как в «this»; не произносите д или з.
Кончик языка поднят к нёбу и не касается его, не вибрирует; губы чуть округлены.
